reason: planning stopped before any code was written: the plan still needed revising in the last round (round 3 of 3). I checked the plan's code references against the snapshot. They hold: `push_if_remote_at` (athena-git lib.rs:373), `RecordsWriter::append`/`append_with_hook` and `RecordsError::Contended`, the `observe_merge` call before the Open branch (gh.rs:1314), `confirm_existing_merge` (gh.rs:1364), the `PrReport` literals (gh.rs and the display.rs:1285 test helper), and `state.job_dir`. In pr.rs, `observe_merge` sets the link to MergedUnverified when the merged content does not match, so writing the landing only for Landed links fits criterion 7. The design fixes the cause: the commit is built on the remote tip, pushed with a lease, and the local ref moves only after the push succeeds. Most demonstrations would fail without the behavior they cover. The gap is criterion 8. The plan wrongly says `Athena::land_pr` cannot run against a fake host, but it takes `runner: &dyn Runner`. Because every records test calls the free `gh::land_pr`, the production wiring in `Athena::land_pr`, which PrLander calls, is never exercised: passing `records: None` there would leave every test green. That is a major finding, and the planner can fix it, so the verdict is revise.
